title: Product Certification Scheme (Scheme I - ISI Mark)
description: Scheme I is the flagship product certification scheme of BIS that allows manufacturers to use the ISI Mark following factory audit and lab testing.
keywords: isi mark; licence application; manakonline; factory audit; scheme 1; cml number
testing_requirements: Factory testing laboratory implementation of Scheme of Testing and Inspection (STI) and independent verification in BIS lab

title: Compulsory Registration Scheme (Scheme II - CRS)
description: Scheme II operates as self-declaration of conformity based registration for electronic goods notified by MeitY and MNRE.
keywords: crs; compulsory registration; meity; electronics; r number; test report
testing_requirements: Testing in BIS-recognized laboratory in India against Indian safety standards followed by online registration on crsbis.in

title: Foreign Manufacturers Certification Scheme (FMCS)
product: ISI Mark Certification for Overseas Manufacturers
description: Grants ISI mark licence to foreign manufacturers intending to export goods to India that fall under mandatory or voluntary standards.
keywords: fmcs; foreign manufacturers; overseas licence; authorized indian representative; export to india
mandatory_status: Mandatory for QCO products imported to India
testing_requirements: Factory inspection by BIS officer at overseas premises and sample testing in Indian laboratories

title: Certificate of Conformity (Scheme IV - CoC)
description: Scheme IV validates specific manufactured batches or custom lots without requiring permanent continuous mass factory licensing.
keywords: coc; certificate of conformity; batch testing; lot validation; scheme 4
testing_requirements: Drawing of sample from specific manufactured lot and laboratory compliance testing against standard
